newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares end week up, seen heading higher.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares end week up, seen heading higher.

text.p: Austrian shares ended higher on Friday on the back of benign U.S. and German inflation data and traders predicted the uptrend would continue next week.
"It's looking good," said one trader. " The new goal until March is 1,250."
Another trader agreed: "I would be disappointed if we did not hit 1,200 points next week."
The ATX index of 21 blue chips climbed 9.04 points, or 0.76 pct, to 1,196.96. Among its constituents 13 shares rose, seven fell and one remained unchanged.
Demand was particularly strong in index heavyweights oil and chemicals group OMV, insurer EA Generali and steelmaker VA Stahl.
OMV was the top gainer, rising 2.93 pct to 1,369 schillings.
Creditanstalt ordinary shares led the decliners, shedding 0.67 pct to 668 schillings.
The February ATX future gained 10.0 points to 1,199.0.
The broad-based Vienna Bourse index added 2.79 points, or 0.63 pct, to 446.47. -- Vienna Newsroom, 43-1-53112-258
